message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have access to live market data, so I can’t give you the exact spot price of gold for today.  

**What you can do instead**

| Source | How to check |
|--------|--------------|
| **Bloomberg** | Visit Bloomberg.com → Markets → Commodities → Gold |
| **Reuters** | Reuters.com → Market Data → Commodities → Gold |
| **Kitco** | Kitco.com → Gold Prices |
| **Investing.com** | Investing.com → Commodities → Gold |
| **Your broker’s platform** | Most brokerage apps (e.g., Fidelity, Schwab, Robinhood) show real‑time gold prices |

These sites update the spot price every few seconds during market hours. If you need the price for a specific time (e.g., closing price), most of them also provide historical charts and daily summaries.
